text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Third track: making samples obey the laws. Four families. Hard: build the law into the network, say a potential whose curl has no divergence, or project each sample while drawing it. Soft: a penalty in the loss, obeyed only approximately. On the distribution: constrain the crowd, by its covariance, or by the equation a steady cloud obeys. And symmetry: an equivariant flow gives a symmetric cloud.
